bio.text: Justin Gonzales is serving his sixth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 89.
He was raised in Gurdon, Arkansas, attended Gurdon High School, and lives in Okolona.
The legislature lists his occupation as farmer, and for the 95th General Assembly he chairs the House City, County, and Local Affairs Committee.
